note_image_suspect: data/image_suspect.csv is REVIEW-ONLY; not an exclusion list.

schema_notes.photo_neighbors: top 15 RRF(bg,srccenter) k=60; excludes self + neighbor_hidden; entry.cosine = min-max of rrf_raw within the 15; entry.rrf_raw kept
schema_notes.photo_neighbors_other_brand: same RRF as photo_neighbors plus other-brand filter (clip_rows brand lower+strip; missing brand matches nothing)
schema_notes.photo_neighbors_score_formula: rrf_raw = sum_l 1/(k+rank_l); score = (rrf_raw - min)/(max - min) within each top-15 list (1.0 if max==min); both fields stored on each neighbor entry
schema_notes.spec_neighbors: top 15 from homage cosine among export-set ids only; excludes row_verified=false and neighbor_hidden; empty if watch not in homage set
schema_notes.spec_neighbors_other_brand: same as spec_neighbors plus other-brand filter; empty if not in homage set
